item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Studios Has Plans For A GHOST RIDER Project In The Post-AVENGERS: SECRET WARS MCU
item.description: A new rumour claims that Marvel Studios is eager to move forward with a new Ghost Rider project following the release of Avengers: Secret Wars at the end of 2027.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY's Fourth Teaser Trailer Leaks Online And Reveals A Meeting Decades In The Making
item.description: The fourth Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer has leaked online, featuring the first meeting between Black Panther and a member of the Fantastic Four, with Namor's shadow also looming large.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Star Sadie Sink Makes A Surprising Admission About Being Cast In The MCU Movie
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day star Sadie Sink has reflected on being cast in the MCU movie, and reveals that she learned of her involvement online before hearing from Marvel Studios.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Trailer #3 Officially Released; The X-Men Make Their Long-Awaited MCU Debut!
item.description: The third Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer has been officially released by Marvel Studios, and it features the long-awaited MCU debuts of Professor X, Magneto, Cyclops, and the Sentinels.

item.title: STAR WARS: Dave Filoni And Veteran Executive Expected To Replace Kathleen Kennedy As Lucasfilm Co-Presidents
item.description: According to a reliable source, Disney has chosen Lucasfilm President Kathleen Kennedy's successors, and as many fans hoped, Dave Filini will indeed serve as the studio's Co-President.

item.title: LOGAN Star Hugh Jackman Once Again Plays A Bearded Badass In THE DEATH OF ROBIN HOOD First Trailer
item.description: The first trailer for The Death of Robin Hood is finally here, and it finds Deadpool & Wolverine star Hugh Jackman exploring the end of the iconic bandit's life.

item.title: THUNDERBOLTS* Star Sebastian Stan Joins THE BATMAN 2 Cast; Barry Keoghan Expected To Return As Joker
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday star Sebastian Stan is in talks for a lead role in Matt Reeves' The Batman Part II, and it sounds like we'll see the Bucky actor put his spin on Harvey Dent...

item.title: TOMB RAIDER TV Series Reveals Full Cast As Jason Isaacs, Sigourney Weaver, More Join Sophie Turner
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios and Phoebe Waller-Bridge's upcoming adaptation of Tomb Raider has filled out its cast with some big names, with Jason Isaacs and Sigourney Weaver among those joining Sophie Turner.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Leaked Trailer #4 May Be Set In A Location That's Key To The Multiverse Saga - SPOILERS
item.description: The fourth Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer leaked online earlier today, but what does its setting tell us about the upcoming movie? There are a couple of exciting possibilities...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Trailer #3 4K Screenshots Reveal A Closer Look At The X-Men's MCU Debut
item.description: We're taking a closer look at today's jaw-dropping Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer with 4K screenshots featuring the long-awaited MCU debut of the original big screen X-Men.
